name: bartaco
notes: Items and prices from bartaco's own online ordering page (Olo) for the Westport location; size prices were read from each item's options. The dine-in menu PDF (CT, Oct 2026) has the same dishes but no prices. Dine-in drinks (cocktails by the glass etc.) are not on the ordering page and are not included; the cocktails, beer and wine listed are the take-out offerings. Hours from the location page ('11am - late, daily'). Free to-go extras (utensils, hot sauce packets) left out.
